headline.title: 3 new ways Ads Advisor is making Google Ads safer and faster
headline.summary: Google Ads has introduced three new features in its Ads Advisor tool aimed at enhancing safety and efficiency for advertisers. These updates focus on improving ad quality, streamlining campaign management, and providing better insights for performance optimization.

articles.title: AI research lab NeoCognition lands $40M seed to build agents that learn like humans
articles.summary: NeoCognition, an AI research lab founded by an OSU researcher, has secured $40 million in seed funding to develop AI agents capable of learning and becoming experts in various domains. The startup aims to create systems that mimic human learning processes.

articles.title: ChatGPT’s new Images 2.0 model is surprisingly good at generating text
articles.summary: OpenAI's ChatGPT Images 2.0 model demonstrates significant advancements in AI by effectively generating text alongside images. This latest iteration highlights the evolution of AI capabilities in recent years.

articles.title: Building agent-first governance and security
articles.summary: As AI agents become more prevalent in organizations, they may create new vulnerabilities that can be exploited to access sensitive information and systems. Companies are urged to implement robust governance and security measures to mitigate the risks associated with the increasing presence of non-human identities.

articles.title: Mozilla Used Anthropic’s Mythos to Find and Fix 271 Bugs in Firefox
articles.summary: Mozilla utilized Anthropic's Mythos to identify and resolve 271 bugs in the Firefox browser. The Firefox team believes that while AI advancements won't drastically change cybersecurity in the long term, software developers may face challenges during the transition.

articles.title: Clarifai deletes 3 million photos that OkCupid provided to train facial recognition AI, report says
articles.summary: Clarifai has deleted 3 million photos provided by OkCupid for training its facial recognition AI following a settlement with the FTC. The data sharing occurred in 2014, with OkCupid's executives being investors in Clarifai at the time.

articles.title: Preventing extinction from ASI on a $50M yearly budget
articles.summary: ControlAI aims to prevent extinction risks from superintelligent AI by advocating for an international prohibition on its development, supported by a $50 million yearly budget. The organization focuses on educating decision-makers and the public about the associated risks to drive action towards this goal.

articles.title: OpenAI’s updated image generator can now pull information from the web
articles.summary: OpenAI has launched an updated version of its image generator, ChatGPT Images 2.0, which now includes the ability to search the web for information to enhance image creation from a single prompt. The new version features improved capabilities for generating more sophisticated images and better adherence to user instructions.

articles.title: Sam Altman throws shade at Anthropic’s cyber model, Mythos: ‘fear-based marketing’
articles.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman criticized Anthropic's new cybersecurity model, Mythos, during a podcast, claiming it employs "fear-based marketing" to enhance its appeal. Altman's comments highlight ongoing competitive tensions in the AI industry.

articles.title: OpenAI Beefs Up ChatGPT’s Image Generation Model
articles.summary: OpenAI has released the ChatGPT Images 2.0 model, which improves image generation capabilities by producing more detailed visuals and better text rendering. However, the model continues to face challenges with languages other than English.

articles.title: Framework’s first eGPUs turn its laptop into a desktop PC
articles.summary: Framework has introduced external GPU (eGPU) modules for its Framework Laptop 16, allowing users to enhance their laptop's graphics capabilities. This development follows the company's earlier promise to enable easy upgrades of internal video cards, further expanding the laptop's versatility.

articles.title: Tim Cook’s Legacy Is Turning Apple Into a Subscription
articles.summary: Tim Cook has focused on transforming Apple into a subscription-based model, significantly expanding its services portfolio. As he prepares to leave, incoming CEO John Ternus will need to adapt the company’s strategy to incorporate advancements in AI.
